nodes.title: Why Choose ZX Bank House Loan?
nodes.summary: Reasons to choose the house loan: attractive interest rates to keep EMIs low, flexible repayment tenure up to 30 years, quick approvals with minimal documentation, loan amount of up to 90% of the property cost (subject to conditions), and zero prepayment charges with part-payment or full foreclosure anytime.

nodes.title: Key Features
nodes.summary: House loan key features: eligible applicants are salaried individuals, self-employed people, and NRIs; the loan amount range is ₹5 lakh to ₹10 crores with a tenure of up to 30 years; processing fee starts at 0.25%; interest type is fixed or floating; top-up loans and balance transfer from other banks are available.

nodes.title: Documents Required
nodes.summary: Documents needed for a house loan: identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID), address proof (utility bill, Passport, Aadhaar), income proof (salary slips, ITR, bank statement, Form 16), and property documents (sale agreement, title deed, approved plan).

nodes.title: How to Apply
nodes.summary: Apply for a home loan online through the ZX Bank home loan portal, via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app (Android or iOS), or by walking into any ZX Bank branch across India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, or Nepal.

nodes.title: Special Benefits
nodes.summary: Special house loan benefits: an additional rate concession for women co-applicants, dedicated relationship managers and online application for the NRIs, and lower rates for eco-friendly or energy-efficient green homes.

nodes.title: Need Help?
nodes.summary: Help options for house loan customers: chat with the Zia AI assistant via the mobile app or NetBanking, call the toll-free number 1800-123-4567 (India), or email loans@zxbank.asia.
